hospital.name: San Joaquin General Hospital

chp_or_dmv.name: California Highway Patrol - Fresno Area
chp_or_dmv.snippet: Our officers patrol over 4,045 miles of state highways, freeways, and unincorporated roadways, serving the communities of Clovis, Reedley, Sanger, Selma, Kingsburg, Kerman, Fresno, Parlier, Orange Cove, Mendota, Fowler, Del Rey, San Joaquin, Auberry, Shaver Lake, Caruthers, Biola, Easton, Riverdale, Laton, and Tranquility.
